address: 27 Battersea Rise, Battersea, London, SW11 1HG, United Kingdom
bio: A classic French bistro and wine shop are rolled into one appealing package at this rustic neighbourhood operation run by a friendly team. The satisfying dishes have a largely French accent, with some Mediterranean influences also coming into play, be it burrata or kalamata olives. The rotisserie chicken to share is something of a speciality, while the thoughtfully compiled wine list includes plenty of natural wines from artisan winemakers....
